problem.badFallback: Choose one of the email-safe fallback fonts.

problem.badFontUrl.message: Use the web font's https stylesheet link, with the font's name.
problem.badFontUrl.note: a web font's CSS link, like https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter

problem.badLogo: That image isn't in this workspace's library. Upload the logo again.
problem.oneSection: A synced block is one section: an mj-section or an mj-wrapper.

problem.compile.note: error: the compiler's own message, in English

problem.needsUnsubscribe: The footer needs the unsubscribe link: every email holding it must have one.
problem.notSaved: Save the brand kit first; the synced Header and Footer start from it.
problem.syncedName: Give the synced block a name, so people can find it in the blocks panel.
problem.alreadySynced: This section is a synced block already, or holds one. Unlink it first to save it as a new one.
problem.holdsSynced: A synced block can't hold another synced block.
problem.keepHeaderFooter: The synced Header and Footer stay: every brand kit has them. Edit them instead.
problem.badWebsite: Enter the website's address, like acme.io.

problem.unreachable.message: {site} couldn't be read ({reason}). Check the address and try again.
problem.unreachable.note: site: the website's host, acme.io; reason: a short technical reason

import.linkContrast.message: {color} isn't used for links. It's {ratio}:1 on white, under the 4.5:1 that small text needs. Links use the next colour on your site.
import.linkContrast.note: color: #6366F1; ratio: a contrast ratio with two decimals, 4.47

import.svgLogo.message: The logo on {site} is an SVG, which Gmail and Outlook don't show. Upload a PNG version.

import.logoNotAdded.message: The logo on {site} wasn't added to the media library: only people who edit campaigns can add images. Ask one of them to import it.
